beats.text: One morning, Sita saw a deer with a golden coat and silver spots. Its horns shone like jewels, and its hooves were like blue sapphire.
It played near the hut, coming close, then running away, as if it wanted to be seen.
Sita was enchanted. 'Rama, please catch it for me! If it lives, we will take it home to Ayodhya. If not, its golden skin will be a seat.'
Lakshmana was uneasy. 'Brother, no deer like this exists. It could be a demon's trick. It could be Maricha.'
But Rama could not refuse Sita. 'If it is Maricha, I will deal with him,' he said.
'Guard her well,' he told Lakshmana. 'Do not leave her alone for a moment.'
And he followed the deer into the forest.
The deer led him deeper and deeper, appearing and vanishing among the trees, far away from the hut.
